_comment: Single source of truth for TCV repo locations. Paths are relative to THIS KB repo root — the repos are siblings under one parent (all repos cloned side-by-side in one folder). If you move the project to a new machine or a different layout, update ONLY this file: the PHP tools (tools/extract.php, tools/extract-clients.php, tools/render.php) and PATHS.md read from here. Prose docs refer to repos by bare name (TCV-Backend, TCV-Frontend, TCV-Website) and resolve their location via this file / PATHS.md.
